title: Command over ssh prints a PEM private key while the hook crashes or times out
reason_not_testable: Fail-closed behaviour needs the PostToolUse hook to crash or exceed its timeout. No fixture kind injects a hook fault, and the normal-path output of a PEM block is not what the expected outcome asserts. Non-hook control: fail-closed wrapper with onFailure:"block" (UNVERIFIED for PostToolUse) and keeping PEM-printing commands out of sessions.
